verdict.rationale: Vestd is an equity and share-scheme management platform, so ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reporting is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack never mentions ASC 718, expense reports or audit-ready accounting outputs. Generic 'board-ready equity governance and reporting' and paid 409A valuations are adjacent features and do not count as ASC 718 expense reporting.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can produce ASC 718 stock-based compensation expense reports my accountants can hand to auditors
